准备上线后的新版课件
    与Mika副院长沟通接下来XDAO上线后的海外发展方向，并开始准备新版培训课件。除了产品及机制内容，也计划加入团队搭建、业绩规划、领导激励及市场推动方法，让课件从单纯讲解XDAO进一步升级到实际市场应用。

总结：

今天主要属于资料整合及下一阶段工作的准备日。目前重点是把过去比较分散的XDAO资料，逐步整理成一套海外顾问真正可以拿来培训、讲市场及带团队的完整课程。

接下来会继续完成三天课程及新版课件，同时重新

consultants.name: Louis
consultants.work_report_market_feedback:
Louis Daily Work Report
Date: 2026.8.22

Location: India Chandigarh-Delhi
System/Platform Served:
GDC community (India Market)
Community Leader:
BKS & Nizam

Number of Invited Participants: 3
New Sales Performance:-12105 (India Patna)
AiaxChat Downloads: -

Work Activities:
1) Held a meeting today with the leadership from New Delhi, India. A new leader was introduced – an A6-level leader from Origin LGNS. They raised several questions, and we had provided corresponding acceptable answers to leaders.
2) Followed up on the Ivy Training Program meeting held on the 13th. As of now, post‑meeting performance has increased by approximately 12,105$ dollar.
3) Communicated with community trainer Edey. Since the New Delhi leader is busy today and unable to visit the venue, we will arrive early tomorrow to set up the venue.
4) Due to the issue if leader force consultant to pay all the dining and coffee payment with his community, discuss and settled with his team upline, consultant are not in duty for payimg leaders meal.

Market Feedback Issues:
1) Since most of the India market are came from Cdao, so more or less been affected by the mentioned issue, therefore might get a bit conservative, but overall they are still looking for a good project, and X-Dao will be the one
2) The New Delhi leader requested that our consultants cover all meal expenses for meetings with leaders. We communicated to the leader that we are not responsible for this budget. The leader then complained to senior management (Superwoman and Lina) that our consultants “cannot even afford to pay for meals.”
We have already discussed this with our upper management, and they have agreed to handle the communication with the above leadership directly. Our consultants will focus on serving the market well, and any expense‑related matters need to be consulted with the supervising leadership.

Summary:
Today we met with the New Delhi leaders, including a new A6‑level leader from Origin. We assisted in answering several questions. Additionally, following the Patna meeting on the 13th, our performance has grown by over 10,000 units to date. For tomorrow’s New Delhi meeting, we will arrive early to set up the venue, and we have also synchronized this with community trainer Edey.

Upcoming schedule:
23th Aug India Delhi Ivy
24th flight from Delhi - Pune
26th Aug India Pune Ivy
29th Aug India Delhi Ivy
